Licensed access and provider marketing assets need exact term, asset, user and use rights. One package receipt must not be counted again for included rights.
Annual service access can leave work and named-user obligations beyond the cash window. Comparator auto-renewal is not adopted for JGA.
Organisational access and a vetted peer seat are different benefits. Payment for one does not satisfy or sell the other by assumption.
A senior-payroll forum or public research is an alternative; public access does not establish Table admission price or paid conversion.
Approved attendee and sponsor benefits have different payers/obligations. Actual booking terms govern credits, cancellation and excluded travel.
